On many routes, cargo can fly the same night and arrive within one to three days. Actual times depend on route, flight availability and clearance at destination.
Is expedited always the most expensive option?
Not necessarily. We first check whether a cheaper option still meets your deadline, such as a consolidation that departs tonight or sea–air.
Do you work weekends and holidays?
Yes. Our air cargo desk in Mumbai works 24×7, and urgent shipments are handled whenever they come in.
Can you speed up a shipment already on its way?
Often, yes. Pre-filing customs papers, arranging delivery orders early and planning the delivery truck in advance can save days at destination.
